how1: Buga abin da suke siya (ko matsa 🍚 Shinkafa, jakar lb 20 don farashin kasuwa na gaske).
how2: Shigar da farashin ɗaya a cikin Amurka (ko matsa guntu).
how4: Ƙara kowane mai karɓa: taɓa ƙasar, ƙara suna / sadaka.
how5: Kowane layi yana nuna abin da za a aika; rubuta ainihin farashin gida idan kun san shi.
how6: Jimlar yana ƙasa; matsa Kwafi shirin don rabawa.
how7: Ko buɗe jerin buƙatun manufa: zaɓi abin da suke buƙata, kwafi bayanin kula, sannan ba da ta hanyar shafin manufa.
howp: Wannan yana tsara adadin. Ba ya aika kuɗi ko tabbatar da ayyukan agaji. Ba da ta kowane shafin hukuma na manufa.
tagline: Ba da don kowa ya saya iri ɗaya.
nosend: Wannan app baya aika kuɗi ko tabbatar da ayyukan agaji. Ba da ta kowane shafin hukuma na manufa.
about1: Matakan farashin daga Bankin Duniya (matakin farashin amfanin gida, galibi 2024; US = 100, an adana shi azaman 1.0). Farashin musaya yana rayuwa a yau. Farashin hukuma na ƙasa = farashin Amurka × 2024 na gida PPP, wanda aka juya zuwa dala a farashin yau. Farashi a hukumance tsadar rayuwa ne, ba kayan abinci ɗaya ba kuma ba farashin waya na yau ba. Buga farashi lokacin da aka san ainihin ɗaya (wanda aka nuna a matsayin "farashin ku").
about2: yana amfani da ainihin farashin shinkafar kasuwa maimakon matakin farashin: Amurka daga Ofishin Kididdiga na Ma'aikata (jerin APU0000701312, matsakaicin birni na Amurka), Haiti da Malawi daga Shirin Abinci na Duniya (via HDX). Ana juya farashin gida zuwa daloli a farashin yau da kullun. 20 lb = 9.07 kg. Kasashen da ba su da farashin shinkafa a kasuwa suna amfani da matakin farashin.
about3: Farashin jerin buƙatun sune farashin kasuwannin kasuwa na Shirin Abinci na Duniya (ta hanyar HDX) don yankin manufa, tare da kasuwa da watan da aka nuna akan kowane abu. Abubuwan da ba su da farashin kasuwa suna faɗin "farashin da aka saita ta manufa".
